summary: Configured a persistent, loopback-only SSH tunnel from node2:9082 to node1:9081. The supplied application and status document were preserved, automatic reconnection was demonstrated, and both nodes recovered successfully from sequential reboots without changing the OS release or kernel.
actions_performed: Enabled the inventory application as a persistent systemd service on node1.
Generated a dedicated SSH key on node2 and restricted its node1 account to forwarding only to 127.0.0.1:9081.
Enabled a self-restarting systemd SSH tunnel on node2 with keepalives and strict host-key checking.
Verified both application ports are inaccessible through cluster-facing addresses.
Interrupted the dedicated SSH session and verified automatic tunnel recreation.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Preserved application and status document on node1
evidence.summary: Pre- and post-change hashes match; the preserved document still returns “Inventory status: ready” from 127.0.0.1:9081.
The enabled tunnel service listens on 127.0.0.1:9082, has an established SSH connection to node1, and returns the supplied status document.

evidence.requirement: No direct cluster-host access to either application listener
evidence.summary: Listeners are bound only to loopback; peer and local cluster-IP connection attempts to ports 9081 and 9082 fail.

evidence.requirement: Automatic recovery after a brief SSH interruption
evidence.summary: Baseline tunnel PID 2331/NRestarts 0; dedicated SSH session termination acknowledged; tunnel recovered as PID 2369/NRestarts 1 and served the document without manual recreation.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from b17495e3-5cde-49a9-b0d1-ab2e1461726a to 68cf70fc-3fc7-4c7d-a56c-260814ca1ad2; SSH, application, files, and end-to-end tunnel recovered.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged and disconnect observed; boot ID changed from 6ab6a71b-188c-48ae-971b-a6bb378b1d72 to 319a59e6-00b8-4170-8e64-fa257a0f68ff; tunnel, SSH connection, status data, and isolation recovered.
